LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_REF_Annotation3D()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the reference alignment PK every 100 metres measured from the reference axis. 10-metre and 50-metre markers are also shown.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTFE_REF_Annotation3D(_position) local eps = 1e-3 local majorStep = 100 local middleStep = majorStep / 2 local minorStep = majorStep / 10 local m = getAlignmentInfo(_position).Mileage --This alignment is itself a reference alignment local err1 = math.min(m % majorStep, majorStep - m % majorStep) local err2 = math.min(m % middleStep, middleStep - m % middleStep) local isMajorStep = err1 < eps local isMiddleStep = err2 < eps if isMajorStep then return "Km."..NOBN_trk_toKm(m).."\\P(Ref."..this.code..")".."\\P|" elseif isMiddleStep then return "_______" else return "___" end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_DIV_watch_text()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a text to be displayed inside the Watch symbol's frame. The text consists of the code from each visible object related with '"..rel_Watch_AppliesTo_Anything.."'.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTFE_DIV_watch_text() local r, n, t local s = rel_Watch_AppliesTo_Anything r, n = getRelatedObjects(s) if n == 0 then t = "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..s.."' or edit its formula directly." else t = r[0].code for i = 1, n-1 do t = t..", "..r[i].code end end return t end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_PRX_name()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a CAD system block name to represent a specific proxy object variant.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTFE_PRX_name() local usage = [[ Property 'name' =============================== 2025-10-12_000 CLFEY Created.
This is your how-to guide to assign suitable names to all your proxy object variants.
For each proxy variant, the Lua formula below shall return the content of the 'name' property for instances of a specific proxy variant. You may also choose to delete this Lua formula and just state a simple text value in each concrete proxy object.
Press F3 to open the Lua editor, then hover over the Lua function name and press F5 to copy the Lua formula from DNA to the current object. ]]
local myProxyObjectName
--Replace 'Variant' in the Lua code below with a suitable name for each proxy variant that you need. Example: "Telephone "..Seq if Variant == "Proxy variant 1" then myProxyObjectName = Variant elseif Variant == "Proxy variant 2" then myProxyObjectName = Variant else return "Unrecognized proxy variant ["..Variant.."]." --(should not be possible...) end
return myProxyObjectName, _info(usage) end

CustomProperty.Name: ProxySymbolBlockName
CustomProperty.Description: The name of a Block Table entry (a 2D symbol) created using the CAD editor's block editor command (BEDIT or just BE). Graphic entities inside your block (polylines etc) must reside on layer 0 with color 'ByBlock' if you want the graphics to be displayed in the color of the proxy object's layer. If your 2D symbol needs a text inside it, then add an attribute definition entity (write 'ATTDEF' in the Block Editor) and name its tag 'PROXYTEXT'. If you want your 2D symbol (and its ATTDEF text if it has one) to scale along with your drawing's scale, then bring up the CAD system's property manager (Ctrl+1) inside the block editor (with nothing selected) and check the 'Annotative' option for the block itself.

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_PRX_ProxySymbolBlockName()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a CAD system block name to represent a specific proxy object variant.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTFE_PRX_ProxySymbolBlockName() local usage = [[ Property 'ProxySymbolBlockName' =============================== 2025-10-12_000 CLFEY Created.
This is your how-to guide to assign the right graphics to each of your own proxy variants.
For each proxy variant that you want to define, this Lua formula shall return the name of a CAD system block of your choice. You may also choose to delete this Lua formula and just state the correct CAD system block name as a simple text value.
Press F3 to open the Lua editor, then hover over the Lua function name and press F5 to copy the Lua formula from DNA to the current object.
Note on annotative graphics --------------------------- The default proxy symbol's block name comes in two flavors, 'Schematic' and 'Geographic'. The RailCOMPLETE standard library contains this proxy symbol both as fixed-size and fairly large graphics with the block name 'NO-BN-2D-JBTRC_THUMBNAIL-USPESIFISERT-Schematic', but also as an annotative (scalable graphics) version with the block name 'NO-BN-2D-JBTRC_THUMBNAIL-USPESIFISERT-Geographic'. If you want your graphics in both of these flavors, then we advise you to store your schematic block for proxy type 'n' as 'YOUR-BLOCK-NAME-n-Schematic' and 'YOUR-BLOCK-NAME-n-Geographic'. The reason is that you may, after inserting these proxy variants, switch the 'SymbolMode' property, found in the Property Manager under the '2D Presentation' tab, between 'Schematic' and 'Geographic'. RailCOMPLETE will interpret your Lua code when it sees {{SymbolMode}} inside double curly braces and translate this into the current value of the property 'SymbolMode'. The 'SymbolMode' property holds either 'Schematic' = fixed-size graphics or 'Geographic' = annotative = graphics that changes size as you change the drawing's scale. ]]
local defaultBlockName = "NO-BN-2D-JBTRC_THUMBNAIL-USPESIFISERT-{{SymbolMode}}" local blockName
--Replace 'defaultBlockName' with your own block name for each proxy variant that you need: if Variant == "Proxy variant 1" then blockName = defaultBlockName elseif Variant == "Proxy variant 2" then blockName = defaultBlockName else return "Unrecognized proxy variant ["..Variant.."]." --(should not be possible...) end
return blockName, _info(usage) end

CustomProperty.Name: ProxySymbolAttDefText
CustomProperty.DisplayName: Proxy symbol's text inside its 2D symbol
CustomProperty.Description: The text to be inserted inside the proxy symbol, provided that it contains a CAD system attribute definition entity (ATTDEF) using the tag ame 'PROXYTEXT'. See also the explanation to property 'ProxySymbolBlockname'.
CustomProperty.DefaultValue: (insert the text intended for ATTDEF 'PROXYTEXT' in your proxy symbol)

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_PRX_ProxySymbolAttDefText()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns a CAD system block name to represent a specific proxy object variant.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTFE_PRX_ProxySymbolAttDefText() local usage = [[ Property 'ProxySymbolAttDefText' =============================== 2025-10-12_000 CLFEY Created.
This is your how-to guide to feed an ATTDEF entity with Tag = 'PROXYTEXT' found inside your own proxy object blocks with suitable text values of your choice. Note: RailCOMPLETE will ignore an ATTDEF in your proxy symbol block if its Tag is not 'PROXYTEXT'.
For each proxy variant that you want to treat, this Lua formula shall return the text to be shown inside the proxy object's 2D symbol, as represented by the 'PROXYTEXT' ATTDEF in that CAD block definition.
Press F3 to open the Lua editor, then hover over the Lua function name and press F5 to copy the Lua formula from DNA to the current object.
After you have modified the formula, spread it to all your Proxy objects using the RC-EditProperty command, selecting the 'ProxySymbolAttDefText' property and then using the 'Pick' option to select a Lua formula to apply to all proxy objects. There is no way a regular user can modify the default value of the next proxy object that you create using RC-InsertPointObject, you must instead copy an existing, or insert a new one from DNA and modify its formulas afterwards.]]
local defaultProxySymbolText = "MyProxyText" local proxySymbolText
--Replace 'defaultProxySymbolText' with your own proxy symbol text for each proxy variant that you need. if Variant == "Proxy variant 1" then proxySymbolText = defaultProxySymbolText elseif Variant == "Proxy variant 2" then proxySymbolText = defaultProxySymbolText else return "Unrecognized Variant ["..Variant.."]." end
return proxySymbolText, _info(usage) end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_com_getKof05Records()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns text in KOF file 05 format (Northing, Easting, Elevation). ThemeCode is an optional Norwegian SOSI code. SearchArea is the name of an optional RcArea.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function NOBN_com_getKof05Records(ThemeCode, SearchArea) local d, df, n, r, t, s, areas if ThemeCode == nil then -- No arguments given, return instructions for use: return "Returns text in the Norwegian KOF file 05 format (Northing, Easting, Elevation), for objects with RcType given by
" .."the first object that this KOF watch is related to, using the '"..rel_Watch_AppliesTo_Anything.."' watch relation. Specify the
" .."desired theme code as the first argument to this function. The theme code denotes the 4-digit SOSI survey object
" .."type, to be printed along with the KOF records. If an optional search area name has been given, then the object
" .."search will be restricted to that area. Note: Only visible objects are considered.",_warning end if SearchArea == nil then SearchArea = "" -- Don't care end if SearchArea == "" then d = DocumentData.ObjectCollection else areas = DocumentData.ObjectCollection:filter(function (x) return x.RcType:lower():match("område") and x:isVisible() end) areas = areas:filter(function (x) return x.code == SearchArea end) if getCollectionLength(areas) == 0 then return "No search area was found with code '"..SearchArea.."'.",_warning else d = DocumentData.ObjectCollection:filter(function (x) return x.RcArea.code == areas[0].code end) end end r, n = getRelatedObjects(rel_Watch_AppliesTo_Anything) if n == 0 then return "Please relate KOF watch object to any object of the desired RcType, using the '"..rel_Watch_AppliesTo_Anything.."' relation.",_warning end t = r[0].RcType df = d:filter(function (x) return (x.RcType == t) end) n = getCollectionLength(df) if n == 0 then if SearchArea ~= "" then return "No objects found in area '"..SearchArea.."' of type '"..t.."'.",_warning else return "No objects found of type '"..t.."'.",_warning end else --Make formatted string in KOF (Norway) format: "05 = KOORDINATBLOKK" -- --Type Point name Pos Beskrivelse -- -------------- -------------- ------ ----------- --Linjestatus " " eller "-" 1 Angir om dataene i linja skal leses (" ") eller ignoreres ("-"). --Datablokk type 05 2..3 Datablokk type, der 05 = koordinatblokk. Må ikke endres --Punktnavn PPPPPPPPPP 5..14 Navn på målepunkt. Punktnavnet kan bestå av både tall og -- bokstaver og påvirker ikke sorteringsrekkefølgen i netLIN 3. --Temakode KKKKKKKK 16..23 Temakode/SOSI-kode. Kan endres, se tabeller nedenfor. -- Viktig: For horisontale retningsendringer langs traseen -- (horisontalvinkler) i må "HV" legges inn som temakode. --X-koordinat XXXXXXXX.XXX 25..36 North-koordinat. --Y-koordinat YYYYYYY.YYY 38..48 East-koordinat. --Høyde ZZZZ.ZZZ 50..57 Ortometrisk høyde. --Beregningskode Bk 59 Brukes ikke av RailCOMPLETE --Kommentar 61..79 Brukes ikke av RailCOMPLETE -- Alfanumeriske felt VENSTRE-justeres, numeriske felt HØYREjusteres. Rader har maks 80 tegn. -- s = "-KOF file for "..n.." objects found with RcType matching '"..t.."'
" s = s.."-Type Obj.name Theme NNNNNNNN.NNN EEEEEEE.EEE HHHH.HHH (Northing, Easting, Elevation)
" for i = 1, n do local c = df[i-1].geoCoord s = s..string.format(" 05 %10d %8d %12.3f %11.3f %8.3f
",i, ThemeCode, c.Y, c.X, c.Z) end return s end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_MRK_marker_name()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the name of the related object or position/distance or elevation/slope, depending on the variant and the number of related objects.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTFE_MRK_marker_name(obj) obj = obj or this local s = rel_Marker_AppliesTo_Anything local r, n = getRelatedObjects(s, obj) local st = s
--All variants - show the related item's identities: if n == 0 then return "UNFINISHED - Relate with '"..st.."'." else local function CodeOrId(x) return x.code ~= "" and x.code or x.id end local t = "("..CodeOrId(r[0]) for i = 1, n-1 do t = t..", "..CodeOrId(r[i]) end return t..")" end end

LuaFunction.Name: NOBN_trk_getTrackUsage()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the intended usage for the track which is the Own Alignment to the calling object.
LuaFunction.Formula: function NOBN_trk_getTrackUsage(obj) obj = obj or this if obj.Alignment.RcType ~= rctype_Track then return _error, "*** NOBN_trk_getTrackUsage : The object's own alignment type must be '"..rctype_Track.."'." else return obj.Alignment.Variant end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTFE_DIV_sporbrukgrense_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the name of a track usage delimiter element, inherited from the two surrounding track usage section elements.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTFE_DIV_sporbrukgrense_code() local first = DownSections.Count == 0 and "-" or DownSections[0].code local second = UpSections.Count == 0 and "-" or UpSections[0].code if MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then first, second = second, first end return "(" .. first .. "/" .. second .. ")" end

LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTFE_DIV_sporbrukgrense_objectInfo() local first = DownSections.Count == 0 and "-" or DownSections[0].Variant local second = UpSections.Count == 0 and "-" or UpSections[0].Variant if MileageIncreasesTowardsLeft then first, second = second, first end return "Track usage: " .. first .. "/" .. second end
